must.title: System Security
must.description: Implement security measures to protect against unauthorized access and data breaches.
must.metric: Zero critical vulnerabilities in security audits
acceptance_criteria: Security audits reveal no critical vulnerabilities.
Access logs are reviewed weekly for suspicious activity.
Security patches are applied within 48 hours of release.

must.title: System Reliability
must.description: Ensure the system is reliable and available with minimal downtime.
acceptance_criteria: Downtime incidents are documented and analyzed for improvements.
Redundancy measures are in place to prevent data loss.

should.title: System Performance
should.description: Ensure the system meets performance benchmarks for speed and efficiency.
should.metric: System response time < 200ms under peak load
acceptance_criteria: Performance tests show response times consistently under 200ms.
System maintains performance under simulated peak load conditions.
Performance metrics are logged and reviewed monthly.

should.title: System Scalability
should.description: Design the system to handle increased load without performance degradation.
acceptance_criteria: Load tests confirm support for 10,000 concurrent users.
System performance remains stable under increased load.

should.title: System Usability
should.description: Enhance the usability of the system to improve user satisfaction.
acceptance_criteria: User feedback is collected and results in actionable improvements.
Training materials are updated to reflect system changes.
